claim_boundary: One-case prefix-only competence control on the already-open single_lift_cloth source interaction. It cannot establish Bayesian-PhysTwin improvement, calibration, independent transfer, or state of the art.
question: Can a frozen joint multiview RGB-D tracker recover the nine benchmark material identities over the held-out portion of the allowed PhysTwin prefix accurately enough to justify a separately locked Bayesian assimilation smoke?

tracker.name: MVTracker
tracker.runtime_choices: Official public predictor defaults, bfloat16 inference, seed 72, deterministic cuDNN, official automatic scene normalization to camera radius 6.3, and exact query-frame anchoring.

source_artifacts.query_source: Only the nine benchmark 3D query locations at source frame 90.
source_artifacts.withheld_source: Manual identity trajectories on frames [90, 121), inaccessible to prediction and opened only after prediction sealing.

competence_gate.pass_action: Freeze a separate assimilation method and gate before reading any PhysTwin future score.
competence_gate.fail_action: Stop the MVTracker-to-PhysTwin route without tuning tracker, camera, depth, normalization, visibility, or anchoring choices.

forbidden: running prediction before the source artifact hashes and locked status replace the prelock placeholders
using any RGB, depth, manual track, point cloud, or simulator outcome at or after frame 121
changing tracker, checkpoint, cameras, depth handling, normalization, query identities, visibility threshold, or gates after prediction
describing a competence pass as Bayesian-PhysTwin improvement or state-of-the-art evidence
opening or modifying any held-v8 target, query, score, barrier, or outcome artifact
